cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised the bride we could open the hall without bothering her. Keep its key away from that teacup; the invitation has our only copy of the address.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too late. The key fell in. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop rubbing. The paper's stuck to the key and the ink is running; lay them flat before separating them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can peel the paper off, but the address is gone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then dry the key on a cloth and call the bride. Ask where to take it before saying we can open up; the part that gets us in has erased the part that gets us there.
